correctness.rationale: A uniform cellular proof shows H2=0 integrally: the ordered cubical model has no allowed left-edge product squares, and first homology of its underlying graph injects via those left-edge coordinates; twofold chain transfer yields vanishing in the unordered model. Explicit counts give Euler rank; a signed complete classification of fixed cells under arm permutations and pole swap gives the trace formula. The exterior-square character identity plus semisimplicity proves the rational representation. Every group element for m=3,4,5 and boundary ranks for m=3,...,6 were checked by the embedded executed code. The proof quantifies over every m>=3 independently of the finite checks.

value.rationale: The uniform all-arm rational homology representation distinguishes arm-permutation cycle types and orientation-reversing pole symmetry, and determines rational acyclicity of two natural quotient families. These are structural topology and equivariant invariants for infinitely many graph braids not determined by the known binomial Betti rank or one previously classified four-arm example. It is not a routine isolated parameter increment; the signed cell count is uniform across arbitrary m.
